description: This file is a shell script used for router configuration and management tasks, including interface setup, hostapd management, DHCP configuration, firewall rules, and service restarts.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the 2G interface by bringing interfaces down and up, and killing existing hostapd processes.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the 5G hostapd service by removing and reloading kernel modules, and restarting hostapd with the 5G configuration.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the WLAN0 interface similarly to Restart_Hostapd.
